frames.narrative: A young knight arrives at a stone castle.
frames.exactIntent: A young knight on horseback arriving at the gates of a grand stone castle under cloudy skies.
frames.adaptedExpression: Young knight in armor walking toward a stone castle gate. Tall castle towers. Overcast sky.

frames.narrative: The knight meets an old king in the castle hall.
frames.exactIntent: A young knight and an old crowned king facing each other and speaking in a castle hall.
frames.adaptedExpression: Young knight and elderly king standing near each other in a stone castle hall. Both clearly visible.

frames.exactIntent: Enemy forces approaching a castle with torches and weapons under a dark threatening sky.
frames.adaptedExpression: Dark castle silhouette. Distant fires and smoke. Ominous night sky. Threat approaching.

frames.narrative: The knight protects the old king.
frames.exactIntent: A young knight standing in front of an old king, blocking an enemy attack, protecting the king in a castle hall.
frames.adaptedExpression: Young knight holding a sword, standing alert beside an old king. Castle hall under threat. King close behind the knight.

frames.narrative: After the battle, the king thanks the knight.
frames.exactIntent: An old king gratefully thanking a young knight after battle, emotional gratitude relationship in a damaged castle hall.
frames.adaptedExpression: Old king placing a hand on a young knight's shoulder. Quiet castle hall after battle. Smoke outside window.

C.label: mixed-local-cloud
C.note: Frames 1-3 Local; frames 4-5 Cloud (difficult relationship beats). Comparison only.
